_note: Model ids verified against provider docs on 2026-08-18. Tiers escalate in capability and cost: bulk carries the high-volume daily sampling, grounded needs reliable web-search tool use, reasoning runs the monthly index and the canonical reconciliation. Re-verify when a provider ships a new generation; a retired id fails the whole run rather than degrading.

bulk.purpose: High-volume ungrounded daily sampling. Cheap tier.

grounded.purpose: Daily web-grounded pass. Needs a capable model with current-generation web search.

reasoning.purpose: Monthly Problem Index and canonical reconciliation. Frontier tier.

openai.label: ChatGPT
openai._note: All three ids support v1/chat/completions, structured outputs, and the web_search tool, which is what the provider module uses. They also support v1/batch, an unimplemented 50% cost saving if this provider's volume grows.

google.label: Gemini
google._note: gemini-3.7-flash is used for the reasoning tier rather than gemini-3.1-pro-preview: the only Pro-tier model in the 3.x line is still preview, and an unattended cron should not depend on a model that can change or be withdrawn without notice. Revisit when a stable Pro ships.

sampling._note: Three ungrounded samples give a variance band; a single number reported to two decimals from one sample is not credible. The grounded pass runs once because search results move less between samples and it is the expensive tier.

budget._note: Projected cost of a run is computed before any API call and the run refuses to start if it exceeds max_run_usd. This is the primary guard: it needs no history, so it works on a first run, and it catches the failure mode where a run submits far more work than intended. A steady-state night projects around $1.00, so 3.00 leaves headroom for a legitimate two-day backfill while still stopping a seven-day stampede. max_rolling_7d_usd is the secondary guard, computed from recorded usage; it catches gradual drift and price rises but is blind to runs whose results never persisted.

pricing._note: USD per million tokens, verified 2026-08-18. batch_discount applies to providers whose daily work goes through a batch API. search_per_call is the built-in web-search tool charge.

token_estimates._note: Fallback only. Once data/raw holds responses, measured averages per provider and pass replace these, so the guard sharpens as the series grows.
